review_candidates.title: BIM Electrical Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: JOB RESPONSIBILITIES 1. BIM MODELING & DOCUMENTATION • Develop and maintain accurate electrical BIM models using Revit MEP, covering power, lighting, and low-current systems where applicable. • Maintain electrical model version control and documentation according to the project BIM Execution Plan. • Collaborate with multidisciplinary BIM teams to maintain a coordinated, clash-free model. REQUIREMENTS • Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering. • Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience applying
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: REQUIREMENTS • Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering. • 6–15 years of total construction experience, combining site execution and technical office experience. • Minimum 4 years of hands-on professional BIM experience. • Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience applying the Saudi Building Code (SBC). • Proficiency in Microsoft Office. CORE COMPETENCIES Analytical Thinking | Problem Solving | Attention to Detail | Technical Coordination | Communication | Teamwork | Time Management | Accountability | Ability to Work Under Pressure SALARY • 5–8 years of experience: EGP 45,000 – 55,000 • 9–15 years of experience: EGP 50,000 – 65,000 Salary is based on experience and qualifications.
